expressions.name: Setpoints
expressions.expression:
// MVR setpoints + tuning. Temps degC, press psia. Heater outputs are PWM duty 0..1.
static.runSystem    = 0
static.timeIncSec   = 0.00625
static.evapPressSet = 14.7
static.evapTempSet  = 100.0
static.superheatSet = 3.0
static.blowerRpmSet = 1500
static.feedRpmSet   = 60
static.kpSuper  = 0.05
static.kiSuper  = 0.01
static.kpMakeup = 0.05
static.kiMakeup = 0.01
static.surgeThresh = 1.0      // degC dT below which the bypass starts opening
static.surgeGain   = 5.0      // V per degC of surge
static.condLevelThresh = 2.5
static.demisterThresh  = 2.5
static.maxEvapPress    = 25.0
static.maxSteamPress   = 35.0
static.minSuperheat    = 0.5
static.maxVaporOut     = 140.0
static.productionSet = 0.3
static.feedPerLpm    = 100
static.autoBlow      = 0
static.autoFeed      = 0

expressions.name: SteamTables
expressions.expression:
// Saturation temps (Antoine, high range) + superheat. Tsat(P_psia) -> degC.
ep = "AI:EvapPress"
sp = "AI:SteamPress"
epmm = ep * 51.7149
spmm = sp * 51.7149
evapTsat  = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(epmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
steamTsat = 1810.94 / (8.14019 - log(spmm) / 2.302585) - 244.485
static.evapTsat     = evapTsat
static.steamTsat    = steamTsat
static.superheatIn  = "TC:VaporIn"  - evapTsat
static.superheatOut = "TC:VaporOut" - steamTsat
static.deltaT       = steamTsat - evapTsat

expressions.name: Interlocks
expressions.expression:
// Safety interlocks -> heatOK / trip / alarm / HeaterEnable.
ep = "AI:EvapPress"
sp = "AI:SteamPress"
shIn = static.superheatIn
vout = "TC:VaporOut"
flood = "AI:DemisterFlood" > static.demisterThresh
trip = 0
trip = trip or (ep > static.maxEvapPress)
trip = trip or (sp > static.maxSteamPress)
trip = trip or (vout > static.maxVaporOut)
trip = trip or flood
trip = trip or (static.runSystem and (shIn < static.minSuperheat))
static.trip = trip
heatOK = static.runSystem and (trip == 0)
static.heatOK = heatOK
"DO:HeaterEnable" = heatOK
"DO:Alarm" = trip

expressions.name: SuperheatControl
expressions.expression:
// Superheat heater PI -> DO:SuperHtr PWM duty 0..1 (gated by heatOK).
err = static.superheatSet - static.superheatIn
iPrev = static.superI
i = iPrev
duty = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiSuper * err * static.timeIncSec
    i = clamp(i, 0, 1)
    duty = static.kpSuper * err + i
    if ( duty > 1 ) then
        duty = 1
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( duty < 0 ) then
        duty = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
endif
static.superI = i
static.superDuty = duty
"DO:SuperHtr" = duty

expressions.name: MakeupControl
expressions.expression:
// Makeup/boiling heater PI -> DO:MakeupHtr PWM duty 0..1 (gated by heatOK).
err = static.evapTempSet - "TC:EvapTemp"
iPrev = static.makeupI
i = iPrev
duty = 0
if ( static.heatOK ) then
    i = iPrev + static.kiMakeup * err * static.timeIncSec
    i = clamp(i, 0, 1)
    duty = static.kpMakeup * err + i
    if ( duty > 1 ) then
        duty = 1
        i = iPrev
    endif
    if ( duty < 0 ) then
        duty = 0
        i = iPrev
    endif
endif
static.makeupI = i
static.makeupDuty = duty
"DO:MakeupHtr" = duty

expressions.name: BlowerControl
expressions.expression:
// Blower (VFD) production knob + proportional anti-surge bypass on AO (0-10V).
run = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0)
"VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = run
if ( run ) then
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM" = static.blowerRpmSet
    "VFD:VFD 1.DIR" = 0
endif
bypassV = (static.surgeThresh - static.deltaT) * static.surgeGain
bypassV = clamp(bypassV, 0, 10)
if ( run == 0 ) then
    bypassV = 0
endif
static.bypassV = bypassV
"AO:BypassValve" = bypassV

expressions.name: FeedwaterControl
expressions.expression:
// Feedwater peristaltic (stepper) dosing rate; gated by runSystem & not trip.
run = static.runSystem and (static.trip == 0)
"STEP:Feed.ENABLE" = run
if ( run ) then
    "STEP:Feed.VELOCITY" = static.feedRpmSet
else
    "STEP:Feed.STOP" = 1
endif

expressions.name: CondensatePump
expressions.expression:
// Condensate pump on/off with hysteresis on the CondLevel switch.
lvl = "AI:CondLevel"
on = static.condPumpOn
hi = static.condLevelThresh
lo = static.condLevelThresh - 0.5
if ( lvl > hi ) then
    on = 1
endif
if ( lvl < lo ) then
    on = 0
endif
static.condPumpOn = on
"DO:CondPump" = on

expressions.name: DemisterDrain
expressions.expression:
// Demister: drain whenever liquid water is present.
"DO:DemisterDrain" = "AI:DemisterWater" > static.demisterThresh

expressions.name: monitorMotor
expressions.expression:
// Read the VFD for motor performance values

rpm = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
voltage = "VFD:VFD 1".VOLTAGE
current = "VFD:VFD 1".CURRENT
powerkw = "VFD:VFD 1".POWER
torque  = "VFD:VFD 1".TORQUE
accel   = "VFD:VFD 1.P0.12"
accelRaw = "VFD:VFD 1#0xF012"
sink    = "VFD:VFD 1.P07.06"
enable  = "VFD:VFD 1".ENABLE

static.vfdEnable  = enable
static.vfdOutVolt = voltage
static.vfdOutAmps = current
static.vfdOutPwr  = powerkw
static.vfdTorque  = torque
static.accel      = accel
static.accelraw   = accelRaw
static.sink       = sink

expressions.name: ProductionControl
expressions.expression:
// PLACEHOLDER (disabled): blower follows distillate production.
err = static.productionSet - "AI:CondFlow"
adj = static.blowerRpmSet
if ( static.autoBlow ) then
    adj = static.blowerRpmSet + 50 * err * static.timeIncSec
    adj = clamp(adj, 0, 4025)
    static.blowerRpmSet = adj
endif

expressions.name: FeedFollow
expressions.expression:
// PLACEHOLDER (disabled): feed follows production (mass balance).
if ( static.autoFeed ) then
    static.feedRpmSet = static.productionSet * static.feedPerLpm
endif

expressions.name: VFDTest
expressions.expression:
// Test my VFD

state       = static.vfdstate
start       = buttonVars.startVFD
stop        = buttonVars.stopVFD
rpm_cmd     = static.rpmSet
prevRpmCmd  = static.prevRpmSet
prevRpmRead = static.prevRpmRead
current_rpm = prevRpmRead

IDLE       = 0
STARTPARMS = 1
STOPPARMS  = 2
if ( state == 0 ) then
    current_rpm = "VFD:VFD 1".RPM
    if ( prevRpmRead != current_rpm ) then
        print("RPM(VFD) %d", current_rpm)
    endif
    if ( start or (rpm_cmd != prevRpmCmd) ) then 
        state = STARTPARMS
    endif
    if ( stop ) then
        state = STOPPARMS
    endif
else if ( state == STARTPARMS ) then
    "VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = 1            // 1 = enable (start), 0 = disable (stop)
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM"    = rpm_cmd      // set speed in RPM (converted to Hz via the motor)
    "VFD:VFD 1.DIR"    = 0            // 0 = forward, 1 = reverse  (aliases DIRECTION / REVERSE)
    if ( start == 0 ) then
       state = IDLE
    endif
else if ( state == STOPPARMS ) then
    print("writing stop parms")
    "VFD:VFD 1.ENABLE" = 0            // 1 = enable (start), 0 = disable (stop)
    "VFD:VFD 1.RPM"    = 0         // set speed in RPM (converted to Hz via the motor)
    "VFD:VFD 1.DIR"    = 0            // 0 = forward, 1 = reverse  (aliases DIRECTION / REVERSE)
    if ( stop == 0 ) then
       state = IDLE
       print("Going back to IDLE")
    endif
else
    state = IDLE
endif

static.vfdstate    = state
static.prevRpmSet  = rpm_cmd
static.prevRpmRead = current_rpm

expressions.name: VFDRpmFromAO
expressions.expression:
// Convert 0-10V AO to VFD rpm

manual = static.manualRPM

if ( manual == 0 ) then
    volt = "AO:BlowerRPM"
    rpm = volt * 402.5
else if ( manual > 0 and manual < 4025 ) then
    rpm = manual
else
    rpm = 0
endif

static.rpmSet = rpm
